install_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pandoc texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-xetex lmodern librsvg2-bin ca-certificates curl gnupg fonts-lato fonts-firacode && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs libnss3 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libx11-xcb1 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libgtk-3-0 libxshmfence1 libglu1-mesa fonts-liberation xdg-utils && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli puppeteer && PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=/opt/puppeteer npx puppeteer browsers install chrome-headless-shell
auth_script:
mkdir -p /tmp/mmdc && CHROME_PATH=$(find /opt/puppeteer -name 'chrome-headless-shell' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1) && printf '{"args":["--no-sandbox","--disable-setuid-sandbox","--disable-gpu","--disable-dev-shm-usage"],"executablePath":"%s"}' "$CHROME_PATH" > /tmp/mmdc/puppeteer-config.json && cat > /tmp/md2pdf <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
export PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=/opt/puppeteer
INPUT="$1"
OUTPUT="$2"
if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ -z "$OUTPUT" ]; then
  echo "Usage: md2pdf <input.md> <output.pdf>"
  exit 1
fi
WORKDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap "rm -rf $WORKDIR" EXIT
cp "$INPUT" "$WORKDIR/source.md"
IDX=0
IN_MERMAID=0
MERMAID_BUF=""
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^\`\`\`mermaid ]]; then
    IN_MERMAID=1
    MERMAID_BUF=""
    continue
  fi
  if [ $IN_MERMAID -eq 1 ] && [[ "$line" =~ ^\`\`\` ]]; then
    IN_MERMAID=0
    IDX=$((IDX + 1))
    printf "%b" "$MERMAID_BUF" > "$WORKDIR/mermaid-$IDX.mmd"
    mmdc -i "$WORKDIR/mermaid-$IDX.mmd" -o "$WORKDIR/mermaid-$IDX.png" -w 800 -b white -p /tmp/mmdc/puppeteer-config.json 2>&1 || echo "WARN: mermaid block $IDX failed to render"
    continue
  fi
  if [ $IN_MERMAID -eq 1 ]; then
    MERMAID_BUF="${MERMAID_BUF}${line}\n"
  fi
done < "$INPUT"
IDX=0
IN_MERMAID=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^\`\`\`mermaid ]]; then
    IN_MERMAID=1
    IDX=$((IDX + 1))
    if [ -f "$WORKDIR/mermaid-$IDX.png" ]; then
      echo "![](mermaid-$IDX.png){ width=85% }"
    fi
    continue
  fi
  if [ $IN_MERMAID -eq 1 ] && [[ "$line" =~ ^\`\`\` ]]; then
    IN_MERMAID=0
    continue
  fi
  if [ $IN_MERMAID -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$line"
  fi
done < "$INPUT" > "$WORKDIR/processed.md"
cd "$WORKDIR"
pandoc processed.md -o "$OUTPUT" --pdf-engine=xelatex -V geometry:margin=0.75in -V fontsize=10pt -V colorlinks=true -V linkcolor=blue -V urlcolor=blue -V toccolor=gray -V mainfont="Lato" -V sansfont="Lato" -V monofont="Fira Code" -V monofontoptions="Scale=0.9" --highlight-style=tango
echo "PDF generated: $OUTPUT ($(du -h "$OUTPUT" | cut -f1))"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/md2pdf
skill_content:
# Markdown → PDF (with Mermaid diagrams)

Converts a markdown file to a beautifully formatted PDF using Pandoc + XeLaTeX, with full Mermaid diagram support. Mermaid blocks are pre-rendered to PNG via headless Chrome before pandoc runs, so the embedded charts appear in the final PDF.

## Quick start

The wrapper script lives at `/tmp/md2pdf` (the home directory and `/usr/local/bin` are not writable inside sandbox jobs, so the auth_script writes it to `/tmp` at job start).

```bash
/tmp/md2pdf input.md output.pdf
```

That's it. The script:

1. Extracts every fenced ` ```mermaid ` block from the input markdown.
2. Renders each block to a PNG via `mmdc` (the Mermaid CLI), using the puppeteer config at `/tmp/mmdc/puppeteer-config.json` which points at the bundled headless Chrome.
3. Replaces each mermaid block in the markdown with an image embed (`![](mermaid-N.png){ width=85% }`).
4. Runs `pandoc` → `xelatex` with professional styling: 0.75in margins, 10pt body, blue links, Lato body font, Fira Code monospace, tango syntax highlighting.
5. Writes the PDF to the path you specified and prints its size.

## Examples

```bash
# Generate this week's report
/tmp/md2pdf reports/2026-04-07/weekly-report.md reports/2026-04-07/weekly-report.pdf

# Combined with the email tool: render PDF and send as attachment
/tmp/md2pdf reports/weekly.md reports/weekly.pdf
/tmp/send-attachment \
  --to admin@example.com \
  --subject "Weekly Report" \
  --body-file reports/weekly.md \
  --attach reports/weekly.pdf
```

## Supported Mermaid chart types

All Mermaid v10+ chart types render correctly: `pie`, `bar`, `xychart-beta`, `flowchart`, `sequenceDiagram`, `gantt`, `classDiagram`, `stateDiagram-v2`, `erDiagram`, `journey`, etc.

````markdown
```mermaid
pie title Errors by Region
  "London" : 70
  "Sydney" : 15
  "Singapore" : 10
  "Virginia" : 5
```
````

If a Mermaid block fails to render (bad syntax, etc.), the wrapper logs `WARN: mermaid block N failed to render` and continues — the failed block will be silently dropped from the PDF, but the rest of the document still converts. Check `mmdc -i block.mmd -o block.png` directly to debug a specific block.

## Pandoc / LaTeX features

The wrapper passes these flags to pandoc:

- `--pdf-engine=xelatex` — required for Unicode + custom fonts.
- `-V geometry:margin=0.75in` — comfortable margins.
- `-V fontsize=10pt` — body text size.
- `-V mainfont="Lato"` — clean sans-serif body font.
- `-V monofont="Fira Code"` with `Scale=0.9` — code blocks at 90% size.
- `-V colorlinks=true -V linkcolor=blue -V urlcolor=blue` — clickable, coloured links.
- `--highlight-style=tango` — syntax highlighting in code blocks.

You can override any of this by calling pandoc directly instead of `/tmp/md2pdf` if you want different styling:

```bash
pandoc input.md -o output.pdf \
  --pdf-engine=xelatex \
  -V geometry:margin=1in \
  -V mainfont="Liberation Serif" \
  --toc --number-sections
```

## What's installed

- `pandoc` + the `texlive-xetex` family + `lmodern` — PDF rendering.
- `nodejs 20` + `@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` (`mmdc`) — Mermaid → PNG.
- `puppeteer` with the `chrome-headless-shell` browser binary at `/opt/puppeteer/...` — what mmdc actually drives.
- Fonts: `fonts-lato`, `fonts-firacode`, `fonts-liberation`.
- All required X11/GTK libraries that headless Chrome depends on (libnss3, libgtk-3-0, libasound2, libxshmfence1, etc.).

The first job that uses this tool spends ~2-3 minutes installing all of the above; subsequent jobs reuse the cached `claw-tools:{hash}` Docker image and start instantly.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause |
|---|---|
| `mmdc: command not found` | The auth_script didn't run. Container started without the tool. |
| `Cannot find Chrome` from mmdc | The `executablePath` in `/tmp/mmdc/puppeteer-config.json` is wrong. The auth_script auto-discovers it via `find /opt/puppeteer -name 'chrome-headless-shell'`; if that returns nothing, the puppeteer browser install failed during `install_commands`. |
| `Permission denied` writing the PDF | The output path is in a read-only mount. Write to `/workspace/...` or `/tmp/...`. |
| Mermaid block rendered as raw text in PDF | The opening fence isn't `` ```mermaid `` exactly (case-sensitive, no language modifiers). |
| Pandoc complains about font | Available fonts: `Lato`, `Fira Code`, `Liberation Serif`, `Liberation Sans`, `Liberation Mono`. Use one of these in `-V mainfont=` overrides. |
